chairman.name: Prof. Dr. Abdul Karim
message: Welcome to the Department of Civil Engineering at Port City International University. Civil Engineering is one of the oldest and most respected engineering disciplines, focusing on the design, construction, and maintenance of the built environment.

Our department is committed to producing competent civil engineers who can address infrastructure challenges and contribute to sustainable development. With state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and experienced faculty, we provide comprehensive education covering structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation, and environmental engineering.
We emphasize both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, preparing our graduates for successful careers in construction, consulting, and research.

content: The Department of Civil Engineering at Port City International University was established to produce skilled civil engineers capable of meeting infrastructure challenges. Our curriculum covers structural, geotechnical, transportation, and environmental engineering with hands-on practical experience.
